# MiniMax Audio AI

> Advanced AI-powered platform for text-to-speech synthesis and voice cloning across 40+ languages with studio-quality audio output.

MiniMax Audio AI provides cutting-edge speech synthesis technology powered by the Speech-02 model family, enabling developers and creators to generate natural-sounding voices and clone voices in seconds. The platform supports multiple audio formats and offers flexible API integration for content creation, accessibility, and voice generation applications.

## Key Topics

- Text-to-Speech (TTS)
- Voice Cloning
- Speech-02 Model
- Speech-2.6 Variants
- Multilingual Support
- Emotion Control
- Audio Synthesis
- RESTful API
- Voice Generation
- AI Audio Technology
- Real-time Audio
- Content Creation
- MP3/WAV/M4A Formats
- Studio Quality
- Voice Synthesis

## Core Products

- [Text-to-Speech (TTS)](https://minimaxaudio.org/text-to-speech.html): Text-to-Speech product powered by Speech-02 AI technology with 40+ languages and studio quality output
- [Voice Clone](https://minimaxaudio.org/voice-clone.html): Clone any voice in 10 seconds with 40+ languages support and emotion control capabilities
- [Speech-02 Model](https://minimaxaudio.org/speech-02.html): Next-generation speech synthesis model with HD, Turbo, and Lite variants for diverse use cases
